static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可倾诉,但尚not yet与他们充分分享关系困境
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without既往心理治疗/咨询史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑连贯,能自我Reflection并配合度高,倾向用绝对化与Self-deprecation的表述

basic_info.main_problem: 我注意到我对Female友not太友好,这已经在我们的关系中造成了问题.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that my behavior is affecting our relationship and my physical and mental health prompted me to seek counseling at this time.

special_situations.event: 上周日做早餐(煎饼)失败,煎饼糊了,Female友期待一起吃早餐的计划泡汤
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在一件事上失败,就证明我整体能力差,是个糟糕的人/Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把食物扔掉,用'我是个坏Chef'给自己贴标签,与Female友疏离或发脾气
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我连煎饼都not会做,I am a terrible cook.

special_situations.event: Work压力上升,Low mood时,日常小事not按计划进行
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果事情not按计划进行,说明我失控且not够好,后面只会更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提高自我Demands,苛责自己,对伴侣易怒或Withdrawal以避免暴露'not够好'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我根本应对not了这种状况,事情会一团糟.

special_situations.event: 与Female友互动中出现失误或not顺(如计划落空,说错话)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够完美,Female友就会失望,关系会变差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 预先消极Anticipation,少做尝试,回避或Silence以减少被评判的机会
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, it is not good enough,最终会让她失望.

special_situations.event: A small mistake occurs at work or during family activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake can represent overall ability and worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 全盘negate自我,忽视以往成功经验,停止继续尝试
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up again; I am just a failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by the partner and have her own worth seen, maintaining an intimate and harmonious connection
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被negate,让对方失望以至被责怪或疏远
defense_goal: Maintains self-esteem and a sense of control by emphasizing external pressure and self-blame
在关系中保持一定距离以避免被评价为'not够好'

object_relations.self_representation: not够好,容易失败并令他人失望的人
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who was hurt by me and is disappointed, who may judge me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探询其对Female友发火或'做砸了'的细节与原因时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心被评判为'not够好',需要证明行为是因情境所致而非自身缺陷
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing external causes (such as work stress) in an explanatory and restrained tone, weakening personal responsibility; using tactful wording and rational elaboration to reduce emotional exposure.

manifestations: Work stress has reduced interest in and enjoyment of singing and cooking
一旦出错便体验到强烈的失败与without价值感,negate既往成功经验

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在谈及失误时以绝对化标签negate自我(如'I am a failure/坏Chef')
担心自己'not够好',从而在关系中Withdrawal或少做尝试

exception_events.target_problem: 在烹饪失误或事情not按计划时,来访者通常会灾难化地negate自己,并对伴侣发火或Withdrawal,令Relationship tension.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 来访者提到'我以前也做出过好吃的饭菜',与当下的'我是坏Chef'形成对照,说明她在其他情境下能够获得积极结果与自我评价更平衡.
exception_events.reason: 线索:当时not yet发生明显失误,注意到成品Good与他人正向反馈,因而自我评价更为客观,not yet用一次事件定义整体能力.

negative_force: Easily self-deprecating and overgeneralizing in stressful situations
